leads.name: Moreton Bay Fig, Arderne Gardens (reader's tip)
leads.reason: Reader: about 180 years old, 27 m tall, canopy 45 m wide, a protected Champion Tree, called the Wedding Tree; reader's girth 1120 cm. SA Champion Trees register would be the official source. Needs two sources (or a register plus a life check) and a pin resolved from the reader's map link before it ships as a reader-found tree; nothing found against it.
